title: Traffic statistics
scope: Managed direct and proxy traffic · Not a provider bill
search: Search target, process, path or policy group
name: Name
unattributedHelp: Global traffic without connection details. Its target, process and group cannot be determined.
processHelp: Showing the recorded process identity. A software name or shared-host owner has not been independently verified.
failure: Operation failed. Previous results may be out of date.
noSamples: No collection records for this period.
noMatch: Records exist, but none match the applied filters.
zero: Sampling was recorded; no matching bytes were measured.
paused: Collection paused. Saved history remains available.
disconnected: Waiting for the core. Unobserved intervals remain gaps.
coverageHelp: Blank or hatched intervals were not fully sampled. Zero traffic is only known within observed intervals. Byte attribution uses sample-end minute buckets.
excluded: This group selection excludes traffic whose policy group could not be determined.
warnings: Some records could not be read or saved. Results and exports may be incomplete.
privacy: These switches affect future records. Existing history remains until it expires or is cleared. Resuming does not backfill paused traffic.
clearConfirm: Clear statistics for ALL dates and filters? Statistics settings, subscriptions and proxy configuration are preserved. This cannot be undone.
incompleteExport: Export the available records with their incomplete-data warnings?
rangeError: Choose valid dates spanning at most 366 calendar days.
development: Isolated design preview · Synthetic records · No connection to application data
manualUpdates: Custom statistics v1 (development) · Upstream v2.5.8 · Install only validated custom updates manually
recordingOff: New records omit these identity fields
inconsistent: Some global counters disagree with connection details. Those bytes remain unattributed and those intervals are not marked complete.
known: Traffic with an identifiable source in this dimension
pendingDates: Dates are not applied. Results and export still use the displayed applied range.
unsaved: This result contains unsaved records and cannot be exported. Refresh to retry saving.
